name: Nodal T-follicular Helper Cell Lymphoma, Follicular Type
aliases: Follicular type nodal T-follicular helper cell lymphoma

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: WHO Classification of Tumors of Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Tissues (2022)

criteria.description: Presence of follicular growth pattern with neoplastic T-follicular helper (TFH) cells in lymph node biopsy
Expression of TFH markers including PD-1, CXCL13, ICOS, BCL6, and CD10 on neoplastic T-cells
Detection of mutations in genes commonly associated with TFH lymphomas such as RHOA G17V mutation
Exclusion of other peripheral T-cell lymphomas and B-cell lymphomas by morphology and immunophenotyping

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Histopathological confirmation of follicular growth pattern with TFH immunophenotype and presence of characteristic genetic mutations
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires integration of morphology, immunophenotyping, and molecular genetics.

pathognomonic.notes: Typically involves cervical, axillary, or inguinal lymph nodes

pathognomonic.symptomName: Follicular architectural pattern on lymph node biopsy
searchTerms: follicle-like pattern in lymph node biopsy

common.notes: Enlarged spleen detectable on physical exam or imaging

occasional.notes: Mild to moderate anemia may be present

rare.symptomName: Neurological symptoms due to CNS involvement
searchTerms: neurological symptoms from brain or spinal involvement
nerve problems due to central nervous system disease
brain or spinal cord related neurological signs

laboratory: Presence of circulating atypical T-cells in some cases
imaging: CT or PET-CT showing enlarged lymph nodes with follicular pattern
Splenomegaly and hepatomegaly on abdominal imaging
genetic: Mutations in TET2, DNMT3A, and IDH2 genes
other: Immunohistochemistry positive for PD-1, CXCL13, ICOS, BCL6, and CD10
Follicular growth pattern on lymph node histology

distinguishingFeatures: Prominent systemic symptoms with rash and polyclonal hypergammaglobulinemia
More diffuse lymph node architecture without follicular pattern
Absence of TFH markers and T-cell receptor clonality

redFlags: Unexplained persistent night sweats and weight loss
references: Swerdlow SH, Campo E, Pileri SA, et al. WHO Classification of Tumours of Haematopoietic and Lymphoid Tissues. IARC; 2022.
Fangazio M, et al. Molecular profiling of nodal T-follicular helper cell lymphomas. Blood. 2020.
